exposure: having a companion who had active participation
outcome: Shared decision-making regarding mode of delivery
cohort: 350 pregnant women with one prior cesarean section
finding: The study found that 38% of pregnant women with a prior cesarean section were involved in shared decision-making regarding their subsequent mode of delivery, with significant associations found for lower education level, being married/partnered, having a companion actively participate in consultations, and familiarity with the clinician.
mod_finding: Shared decision-making regarding mode of delivery was associated with several factors, including being married/partnered and familiarity with the clinician.
